# PassVault: Copilot instructions

Before any task, read AGENTS.md and docs/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md and follow them exactly.
Always: work in small steps, list the files you will create or change before editing, run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx expo lint` after changes, use fake data only, never log secrets, and never claim something works unless you actually ran it. If a task is big, give me a plan first and wait for my approval.
